name: Inkoku no Torikohime ~Torawareta Botsuraku no Hime Shimai, Inkyou no Hate ni~
original_name: 淫刻の虜姫 ～囚われた没落の姫姉妹、淫教の果てに～
source:
* Play as dungeon master in search of the ultimate sex training scrolls * 
Force two stubborn princesses to help you in an epic heroine-seducing quest. 

Long ago, there was a legendary sex slaver who never met a girl he couldn't "turn". 
In his old age he confessed: "I wrote down my method and sealed it away in a cave." 
But though many tried, no one could ever find his writings. It was forgotten. 

Fifty years later, Hein the Sex Trainer was tasked with turning two princesses. 
But they were very strong, and he was lost for inspiration. "If only I knew the 
legendary method," he thought. And so, princesses in tow, Hein embarked on
an adventure to find the cave... and break all ladies' spirits on the way. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE087298.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
*扮演迷宫之主，寻找至高无上的性爱调教秘籍*
迫使两位顽固公主协助你，踏上勾引众多女主人公的史诗任务。

很久以前，有一名传说中的性奴调教师，从来没有他“驯服”不了的女孩。
晚年时，他坦言：“我把自己的方法记录下来，封存在一座洞窟里。”
无数人曾试图寻找那些记录，却没有一个人成功。秘籍就此被世人遗忘。

五十年后，性爱调教师海因接到任务，要驯服两位公主。
可她们意志极其顽强，海因一时束手无策。“要是我知道传说中的方法就好了。”他想。于是，海因带着两位公主踏上冒险，寻找那座洞窟……并在沿途摧毁所有女性的意志。
